narration.text: At number 5, Speechify offers quick and easy narration. It is perfect for getting started fast.
Coming in at number 4, Play.ht provides realistic voices. It handles long-form podcast scripts beautifully.
Our number 3 choice is Murf AI, delivering studio-quality voiceovers. You get many customisation options.
Next up at number 2, WellSaid Labs generates incredibly natural speech. Its premium quality shines through.
And the number 1 spot goes to ElevenLabs. Its voice cloning and expressive speech are truly unrivalled.
ElevenLabs takes the crown for best AI voice. Which one would you use for your podcast?
